item.description:
BalanceEQ 1.2.0

Choose your headphones, choose Neutral, Harman or Custom, then Apply Correction. One main graph compares the predicted result with your target. Manual EQ is under Advanced; sliders always sort from low to high frequencies. Custom points support dragging and mouse-wheel Q.

Neutral uses the matched reference without added preference bass. Calibration predicts the model response, not guaranteed acoustic flatness. Existing presets are preserved.

This community build is ad-hoc signed and unnotarized. Audio stops during restart; choose Start EQ afterward. macOS may request audio permission again.
